messages.en:
{07 04 00}Oh.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00} Look at you!
{07 14 00}So you've finally decided
to drop by, {04 1f 00}?
{07 0b 00}Have you been on vacation
or something?

{07 00 00}I've missed you so
much, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 04 00}Oh.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00} Vaata sind!
{07 14 00}Nii et sa otsustasid lõpuks
läbi astuda, {04 1f 00}?
{07 0b 00}Kas sa olid puhkusel
või midagi?

{07 00 00}Ma igatsesin sind nii
väga, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 16 00}What happened to you? You
up and disappear for, like,
{04 11 00} weeks?
I've been so worried that
I might have said something
to make you upset.
{07 00 00}Thank goodness you've come
to see me at last. {07 14 00}I feel
so relieved, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 16 00}Mis sinuga juhtus? Sa
kadusid ära umbes
{04 11 00} nädalaks?
Ma olen olnud nii mures,
et ütlesin midagi, mis
sind ärritas.
{07 00 00}Jumal tänatud, et sa lõpuks
mind vaatama tulid. {07 14 00}Mul on
nii kergem, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{0b 03 00}{01 06 00}Long time, no see,{01 07 00}
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.

{07 0b 00}Is it just me, or have you
grown a lot in the past
few days, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
{07 00 00}Well, we can still go
{04 22 00} together,{01 00 00 05 00}
{07 14 00}right, {04 1f 00}?
messages.et:
{0b 03 00}{01 06 00}Pole ammu näinud,{01 07 00}
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.

{07 0b 00}Kas see olen ainult mina,
või oled sa viimastel
päevadel suurem, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
{07 00 00}Noh, me võime ikka koos
{04 22 00},{01 00 00 05 00}
{07 14 00}eks, {04 1f 00}?

messages.en:
{07 04 00}Oh! {01 00 00 0a 00}{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00}! I've
finally found you! After
all this time, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 16 00}I can't believe you left
for {04 11 00} weeks
without telling me.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}
{07 10 00}I wish you'd said something
before leaving, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 04 00}Oh! {01 00 00 0a 00}{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00}! Ma
leidsin su lõpuks! Pärast
kogu seda aega, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 16 00}Ma ei suuda uskuda, et sa
läksid {04 11 00} nädalaks
mulle ütlemata.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}
{07 10 00}Soovin, et oleksid enne
lahkumist öelnud, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
